protocolDosing.notes: FDA-approved oncology dose is 2.5 mg once daily; physique/endocrine off-label micro-dosing 0.25–2.5 mg q2–3d is unvalidated patient-derived practice; t½ ~48 h → steady state at 2–6 weeks

mechanismOfAction.summary: Nonsteroidal (type II/triazole) aromatase inhibitor; competitive and reversible CYP19 inhibitor.
mechanismOfAction.description: Competitively and reversibly inhibits CYP19 (aromatase), reducing estradiol synthesis by 75–95% at 2.5 mg/day. No effect on adrenal steroidogenesis at therapeutic doses. Selectivity >10,000× for aromatase over other CYPs. FDA-approved for breast cancer. WADA S4.1 prohibited in sport. CYP3A4 and CYP2A6 metabolism.
